```{r set-params}
  params <- list(
    report_title = "RBS Program Monitoring Report",
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

required_packages <- c("DBI", "dplyr", "knitr", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (!requireNamespace("odbc", quietly = TRUE)) {
  missing_packages <- c(missing_packages, "odbc")
}

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Install required packages before rendering: ",
    paste(unique(missing_packages), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

normalize_names <- function(x) {
  tolower(gsub("_+", "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)))
}

read_params_csv <- function(path) {
  if (!is.character(path) || length(path) != 1L || !nzchar(path)) {
    stop("`params_csv` must be a single file path.")
  }

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("`params_csv` does not exist: ", path)
  }

  out <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
  names(out) <- normalize_names(names(out))

  if (!"param_type" %in% names(out)) {
    stop("`params_csv` must include a `param_type` column.")
  }

  out$param_type <- normalize_names(out$param_type)

  commodity_country_filters <- out[
    out$param_type == "commodity_country",
    intersect(c("commodity", "country"), names(out)),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  period_filters <- out[
    out$param_type == "period",
    intersect(c("location_id", "implementation_date", "before_days", "after_days"), names(out)),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  list(
    commodity_country_filters = commodity_country_filters,
    period_filters = period_filters
  )
}

prepare_commodity_country_filters <- function(x) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x)) {
    stop("`commodity_country_filters` must be a data frame.")
  }

  names(x) <- normalize_names(names(x))
  required_columns <- c("commodity", "country")

  if (!all(required_columns %in% names(x))) {
    stop("`commodity_country_filters` must include `commodity` and `country` columns.")
  }

  out <- x[required_columns]
  out$commodity <- trimws(as.character(out$commodity))
  out$country <- trimws(as.character(out$country))
  out <- out[nzchar(out$commodity) & nzchar(out$country), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(out) == 0) {
    stop("`commodity_country_filters` must include at least one non-empty commodity/country combination.")
  }

  out$commodity_key <- tolower(out$commodity)
  out$country_key <- tolower(out$country)

  unique(out)
}

prepare_period_filters <- function(x) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x)) {
    stop("`period_filters` must be a data frame.")
  }

  names(x) <- normalize_names(names(x))

  if ("location" %in% names(x) && !"location_id" %in% names(x)) {
    names(x)[names(x) == "location"] <- "location_id"
  }

  required_columns <- c("location_id", "implementation_date", "before_days", "after_days")

  if (!all(required_columns %in% names(x))) {
    stop(
      "`period_filters` must include `location_id`, `implementation_date`, ",
      "`before_days`, and `after_days` columns."
    )
  }

  out <- x[required_columns]
  out$location_id <- trimws(as.character(out$location_id))
  out$location_id[normalize_names(out$location_id) == "all"] <- "all"
  out$implementation_date <- as.Date(out$implementation_date)
  out$before_days <- as.integer(out$before_days)
  out$after_days <- as.integer(out$after_days)

  if (any(!nzchar(out$location_id))) {
    stop("`period_filters$location_id` cannot be blank.")
  }

  invalid_location <- !(out$location_id == "all" | grepl("^[0-9]+$", out$location_id))
  if (any(invalid_location)) {
    stop("`period_filters$location_id` must be a numeric LOCATION_ID or `all`.")
  }

  if (any(is.na(out$implementation_date))) {
    stop("`period_filters$implementation_date` must be coercible to Date.")
  }

  if (any(is.na(out$before_days) | out$before_days < 1L)) {
    stop("`period_filters$before_days` must contain positive integers.")
  }

  if (any(is.na(out$after_days) | out$after_days < 1L)) {
    stop("`period_filters$after_days` must contain positive integers.")
  }

  out$before_start <- out$implementation_date - out$before_days
  out$before_end <- out$implementation_date - 1
  out$after_start <- out$implementation_date
  out$after_end <- out$implementation_date + out$after_days - 1

  out
}

sql_quote_date <- function(x) {
  paste0("'", format(as.Date(x), "%Y-%m-%d"), "'")
}

empty_report_data <- function() {
  data.frame(
    "PPQ280 Record ID" = character(),
    Commodity = character(),
    "Commodity Type Name" = character(),
    "Disposition Code" = character(),
    Disposition = character(),
    "Create Date" = as.Date(character()),
    "Report Date" = as.Date(character()),
    Location = character(),
    "Location ID" = character(),
    "Location Site Name" = character(),
    Origin = character(),
    Pathway = character(),
    Quantity = numeric(),
    "Units of Measure" = character(),
    "Test Period" = character(),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

csv_params <- read_params_csv(params$params_csv)
commodity_country_filters <- prepare_commodity_country_filters(csv_params$commodity_country_filters)
period_filters <- prepare_period_filters(csv_params$period_filters)
```

## Data pull

```{r query-and-shape}
date_start <- min(period_filters$before_start)
date_end <- max(period_filters$after_end)

specific_locations <- unique(period_filters$location_id[period_filters$location_id != "all"])
build_period_query_clause <- function(period_row, locations_to_exclude) {
  location_condition <- if (period_row[["location_id"]] == "all") {
    if (length(locations_to_exclude) > 0) {
      paste0(
        "LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(LOCATION_ID AS varchar(50)))) NOT IN (",
        paste(sprintf("'%s'", locations_to_exclude), collapse = ", "),
        ") AND "
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }
  } else {
    paste0(
      "LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(LOCATION_ID AS varchar(50)))) = '",
      period_row[["location_id"]],
      "' AND "
    )
  }

  paste0(
    "(",
    location_condition,
    "REPORT_DT >= ", sql_quote_date(period_row[["before_start"]]),
    " AND REPORT_DT < DATEADD(day, 1, ", sql_quote_date(period_row[["after_end"]]), ")",
    ")"
  )
}

period_query_clauses <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(period_filters)),
  function(i) build_period_query_clause(period_filters[i, , drop = FALSE], specific_locations),
  character(1)
)

query <- paste0(
  "SELECT  F280_ID,
      COMMODITY,
      CTYPE_NM,
      DISP_CD,
      DISP_NM,
      CREATE_DT,
      REPORT_DT,
      LOCATION,
      LOCATION_ID,
      SITE,
      ORIGIN_NM,
      PATHWAY,
      QUANTITY,
      UNIT_NM
  FROM [PPQ_AQI_ARMDMV2].[AQASMSG].[F280_MV] ",
  "WHERE ", paste(period_query_clauses, collapse = " OR ")
)

db_conn <- DBI::dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  .connection_string = params$connection_string
)
on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(db_conn), add = TRUE)

raw_data <- DBI::dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)

if (nrow(raw_data) == 0) {
  report_data <- empty_report_data()
} else {
  raw_data$report_date <- as.Date(raw_data$REPORT_DT)
  raw_data$location_id_key <- trimws(as.character(raw_data$LOCATION_ID))
  raw_data$commodity_key <- tolower(trimws(as.character(raw_data$COMMODITY)))
  raw_data$country_key <- tolower(trimws(as.character(raw_data$ORIGIN_NM)))

  filtered_data <- merge(
    raw_data,
    commodity_country_filters[c("commodity_key", "country_key")],
    by = c("commodity_key", "country_key")
  )

  build_period_pull <- function(period_row, data) {
    location_matches <- if (period_row[["location_id"]] == "all") {
      !data$location_id_key %in% specific_locations
    } else {
      data$location_id_key == period_row[["location_id"]]
    }

    before_rows <- data[
      location_matches &
        data$report_date >= period_row[["before_start"]] &
        data$report_date <= period_row[["before_end"]],
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    after_rows <- data[
      location_matches &
        data$report_date >= period_row[["after_start"]] &
        data$report_date <= period_row[["after_end"]],
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    if (nrow(before_rows) > 0) {
      before_rows$test_period <- "before"
    }

    if (nrow(after_rows) > 0) {
      after_rows$test_period <- "after"
    }

    rbind(before_rows, after_rows)
  }

  period_matches <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(period_filters)),
    function(i) build_period_pull(period_filters[i, , drop = FALSE], filtered_data)
  )
  period_matches <- period_matches[vapply(period_matches, nrow, integer(1)) > 0]

  if (length(period_matches) == 0) {
    report_data <- empty_report_data()
  } else {
    report_data <- unique(do.call(rbind, period_matches))
    report_data <- report_data[c(
      "F280_ID",
      "COMMODITY",
      "CTYPE_NM",
      "DISP_CD",
      "DISP_NM",
      "CREATE_DT",
      "REPORT_DT",
      "LOCATION",
      "LOCATION_ID",
      "SITE",
      "ORIGIN_NM",
      "PATHWAY",
      "QUANTITY",
      "UNIT_NM",
      "test_period"
    )]

    names(report_data) <- c(
      "PPQ280 Record ID",
      "Commodity",
      "Commodity Type Name",
      "Disposition Code",
      "Disposition",
      "Create Date",
      "Report Date",
      "Location",
      "Location ID",
      "Location Site Name",
      "Origin",
      "Pathway",
      "Quantity",
      "Units of Measure",
      "Test Period"
    )

    report_data[["Create Date"]] <- as.Date(report_data[["Create Date"]])
    report_data[["Report Date"]] <- as.Date(report_data[["Report Date"]])
    rownames(report_data) <- NULL
  }
}
```

```{r write-csv}
report_metadata <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    section = "report_parameter",
    variable = c("report_title", "params_csv", "connection_string", "date_start", "date_end", "query"),
    value = c(
      params$report_title,
      params$params_csv,
      params$connection_string,
      format(date_start),
      format(date_end),
      query
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    section = "commodity_country_filter",
    variable = paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(commodity_country_filters))),
    value = paste0(
      "commodity=", commodity_country_filters$commodity,
      "; country=", commodity_country_filters$country
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    section = "period_filter",
    variable = paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(period_filters))),
    value = paste0(
      "location_id=", period_filters$location_id,
      "; implementation_date=", format(period_filters$implementation_date),
      "; before_days=", period_filters$before_days,
      "; after_days=", period_filters$after_days,
      "; before_start=", format(period_filters$before_start),
      "; before_end=", format(period_filters$before_end),
      "; after_start=", format(period_filters$after_start),
      "; after_end=", format(period_filters$after_end)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

date_summary <- report_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(`Location ID`, Location, `Test Period`) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    min_report_date = min(`Report Date`, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_report_date = max(`Report Date`, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Report Data" = report_data,
    Metadata = report_metadata,
    "Report Date Summary" = date_summary
  ),
  paste0(Sys.Date(), "_f280_program_monitoring_report.xlsx"),
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```
